solution.diagnosis: Likely a campus‑wide Eduroam outage in the library affecting multiple students

steps.action: Forget the Eduroam network on your device and reconnect using your full university username and password
Verify whether other devices or classmates can connect to Eduroam in the same area to confirm a network‑wide issue
Use a temporary workaround such as a wired Ethernet connection, a nearby computer lab, or a mobile hotspot until the outage is resolved
Report the outage to the IT Service Desk, providing building (library), approximate start time, device type, and any error messages you see

assumptions: The problem is not limited to a single device since multiple students reported it
The student has access to an alternative network option for a temporary workaround

communication.channel: IT Service Desk ticket form or help desk counter (see the official university IT page)
communication.subject: Eduroam connectivity issue at the library
communication.body:
Dear IT Service Desk,
I am experiencing an Eduroam connectivity issue at the library. I cannot connect to the network and suspect a library-wide outage. I will report the outage immediately, providing the building, approximate start time, device type, and any error messages. I will also forget the Eduroam network on my device and attempt to reconnect using my full university username and password. I will check if other devices or classmates can connect to confirm a network-wide issue. I will use a temporary workaround such as a wired Ethernet connection or a nearby computer lab until the issue is resolved.
Thank you,
[Your name]
[Student ID]
